title: The Two Factor Authentication WordPress plugin before 1.17.0, All-In-One Security (AIOS) WordPress plugin before 5.5.0…
description: A vulnerability in the Two Factor Authentication and All-In-One Security (AIOS) WordPress plugins allows an attacker who knows a victim's password and has their own two-factor-enabled account to bypass the victim's second-factor authentication by using their own two-factor code, thereby obtaining the victim's session.
